text: 近日，2025年度金融科技发展奖评审领导小组会议在京召开。中国人民银行副行长邹澜、中国证监会副主席刘浩凌出席会议并讲话。会议强调，金融业要深入贯彻落实党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，聚焦做好金融“五篇大文章”，稳步加大金融科技投入与创新探索，积极推动自主可控技术向着“全面好用”“更稳更优”目标迈进，不断提升行业数智化水平，积极探索人工智能在金融管理和服务领域的应用，防范模型应用伴生风险，守牢安全发展底线，促进金融服务提质增效。要持续发挥金融科技发展奖示范引领作用，把握前沿技术发展机遇，夯实数据底座，强化科技治理，更好支撑防风险、强监管、促高质量发展各项工
text_en: Recently, the 2025 Fintech Development Award Review Leading Group meeting was held in Beijing. PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan and CSRC Vice Chairman Liu Haoling attended and delivered speeches. The meeting emphasized that the financial sector must thoroughly implement the spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress and all plenary sessions of the 20th Central Committee, focus on the "five major articles" of finance, steadily increase fintech investment and innovation exploration, actively push independent and controllable technologies toward the goals of "fully usable" and "more stable and better," continuously raise the industry's digital and intelligent level, actively explore AI applications in financial management and services, guard against risks accompanying model applications, hold the bottom line of safe development, and promote higher quality and efficiency in financial services. It is necessary to continue giving play to the demonstrative and leading role of the Fintech Development Award, seize opportunities in frontier technology development, consolidate the data foundation, strengthen tech governance, and better support the work of preventing risks, strengthening regulation, and promoting high-quality development.
